content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00180 If for an ISignal to be received an ISignalProps with handleOutOfRange = ignore is provided, a range check shall be implemented in the receiving signal. If the value is out of bounds, the reception of the ISignal shall not be propagated. In this case the RTE shall behave as if no reception occurred.
